name: reviewing-prs
description: Pull-request reviews for Azure DevOps, GitHub and GitLab with one method: two-dot changeset, verify-don't-read, severity-marked findings anchored to clickable lines on the PR head, a paste-ready comment per finding, documentation checks with cited sources, project-specific delegation to domain skills and the built-in code-review/security-review, and a Draft -> Show -> Approve -> Post gate backed by a PreToolUse hook. REST via git credential fill; no gh/glab/az needed.
